debug_sample_rate.description: DebugSampleRate keeps this fraction (0-1) of trace and debug entries. Default 1.

max_storage_mb.description: MaxStorageMB caps stored log size for this app; the oldest entries are pruned first. 0 means the server default.

columns.description: Columns are attribute keys shown as extra columns in the list.

hidden.description: Hidden are attribute keys removed from the detail view (they are still stored).

title_field.description: TitleField is the attribute shown as the row title instead of the body.

status.description: Status: waiting (nothing seen) | claimed (token accepted, registering) | registered | reporting (first report received) | expired | cancelled.

platform.description: Platform is the tile picked in the wizard; it only shapes the install command.

status.description: Status: waiting (nothing seen) | claimed (token accepted, registering) | registered | reporting (first report received) | expired | cancelled.

health.description: Health is the computed health that makes this an issue.

issue_type.description: IssueType is "stale_data" for stale monitors and omitted otherwise.

down_count.description: DownCount is how many of the last 5 reports were down.

severity.description: Severity is derived from recent failures: high (3+ of the last 5 reports down), medium, low; stale monitors are high.

index.description: Index is the zero-based position of the entry in the request (or the NDJSON line number minus one).

key.description: Key is the secret to send as "Authorization: Bearer <key>". It cannot be retrieved again.

mode.description: Mode is "threshold" (fires when more than `threshold` entries match inside the window) or "absence" (fires when none match, for example a job that must log every hour).

severity.description: Severity, Event and Q filter which entries count (same syntax as the log search: severity=">=error", an exact event name, a text substring).

state.description: State is "firing" while an incident is open for the rule, otherwise "ok".

source.description: Source is "app" for ingested product logs and "agent" for agent service logs.

attributes.description: Attributes is free-form JSON of any shape. Limits: depth 8, 128 keys per entry.

body.description: Body is the human message: a string, or any JSON value (kept as structured data and searchable as text).

event.description: Event is a short stable name for product events, for example payment.failed.

id.description: ID is an optional client-chosen idempotency key (unique per app). Re-sending the same id is a no-op.

request_id.description: RequestID correlates entries of one request or job.

resource.description: Resource describes the emitter: service.name, service.version, deployment.environment, host.name, ...

severity.description: Severity is trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal, an OpenTelemetry number (1-24), or a common alias. Unknown values become info.

timestamp.description: Timestamp is RFC 3339 text, or a number of Unix seconds, milliseconds or nanoseconds. Defaults to the receive time.

cardinality.description: Cardinality is an approximate distinct-value count, capped at 1000.

type.description: Type is the dominant JSON type observed.

truncated.description: Truncated is true when the time range matched more rows than the server will scan.

auth_enabled.description: AuthEnabled is false when Core runs with ORION_ALLOW_INSECURE_NO_AUTH.

notified_at.description: NotifiedAt and AcknowledgedAt are only filled for needs_you.

services.description: Services is the 90-day strip per server, worst first, at most 8.

state.description: State: empty (nothing monitored yet) | ok | issues.

uptime_30d_percent.description: Uptime30dPercent is null until a daily rollup exists.

disable_defaults.description: DisableDefaults turns off the built-in key list. Not recommended.

extra_keys.description: ExtraKeys are additional attribute key names (case-insensitive, any depth) whose values are replaced by [redacted] before storage.

service_log_retention_days.description: Retention windows in days for tables that otherwise grow without bound.
Optional retention windows (days, 1-3650). Omitted fields keep their current value.

report_id.description:
ReportID is an optional agent-generated idempotency key (UUID). Replaying a
report with the same ID for the same monitor stores nothing new.

auto_vacuum.description: AutoVacuum is none, full or incremental; only incremental lets retention shrink the file.

duration_seconds.description:
DurationSeconds is how long maintenance lasts when enabling. Omitted means
DefaultMaintenanceDuration; values above MaxMaintenanceDuration are rejected.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

IngestKey.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and an app ingest key (orion_ik_...). Write-only; created per app.
IngestKey.name: Authorization
